implemented: Raw catalog JSON is validated against the existing draft-2020-12 catalog schema before semantic validation or publication.
Operational publication rejects every synthetic source and every enabled approach because current contracts contain geometry identifiers but no resolvable directed road and stop-line geometry.
Synthetic fixture verification is an explicit validator-only mode; neither the runtime store nor operator import exposes that publication bypass.
PostgreSQL publication uses a transaction and advisory lock, retains prior catalog versions, and atomically switches the unique active version.
The operator command executes migration, import and provider/intersection/approach disable. Disable creates a unique version and persists its reason/evidence audit in the same transaction.
Runtime catalog reads query PostgreSQL and revalidate payloads. Missing catalogs, unsafe legacy payloads and unsupported geometry never become fabricated supported approaches.
Recorded catalogs with disabled approaches can be stored and audited; their supported catalog response is honestly empty. Existing recorded evidence is not relabeled as operational approval.
